image_qa.note: All three new editorial bodies are intentionally image-free. Their only image element is the existing Big Bud Man logo in shared site chrome; no product, device, cultivar, or affiliate image is represented or linked.

search_console.decision: The report covered August 24 through September 20: 518 impressions, one click, 0.2% CTR, and average position 61.6. The only position 4-20 page rows had one to four impressions, so no data-led rewrite was justified; those tiny samples and the single Oklahoma query click were deliberately ignored. Old submitted-sitemap errors were checked against the current live sitemap, feed, and site index rather than treated as a new topic signal.

authority.action: Published a CDC, NIH/NIDA, and EPA grounded lung-exposure decision record; a 48-term primary-source glossary with no-JavaScript fallback; and a regulator-backed pre-roll package and price worksheet. Reciprocal links connect established vape, secondhand-smoke, flower, label, Cannabis 101, and CoA pages. A qualified American Lung Association opportunity was logged; no outreach was sent.
